title: Suksessterte (Norwegian almond “success cake”)
hookLine: Norway-inspired suksessterte (norwegian almond “success cake”) with 10 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Preheat & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat oven to 345°F (175°C) and grease cake form (I use a 27 cm spring form) – you can line the bottom with baking paper if you like. Grind almonds in an almond grinder or food processor. I like to keep them a bit coarse. Incorporate {m53130_1}, {m53130_2}, {m53130_3}, and {m53130_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure almonds first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Bake Until Golden & Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Gently whisk the eggs and sugar together until combined (no longer). Stir in the ground almonds, flour, and baking powder. Pour batter into cake form and bake for about 45 – 50 minutes, monitoring to make sure the top doesn't burn. Incorporate {m53130_5}, {m53130_6}, {m53130_7}, {m53130_8}, {m53130_9}, and {m53130_10} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Add egg yolks, heavy cream, sugar, and vanilla to a saucepan. Heat over low/medium heat while stirring constantly until the mixture thickens – about 15 minutes. Turn up the heat if the mixture doesn't thicken, but be careful not to boil. Let the mixture cool to room temperature and then add the butter. You can use an electric mixer for a fluffy egg cream.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Wait for the cake to cool completely before removing from form and frosting. Let Suksessterte (Norwegian almond “success cake”) cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 6 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Wait until the sponge feels cool to the touch before frosting so your glaze or cream stays thick and glossy.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
